title: information worm
description: narrating the inherent contradictory dynamics of the forced breath inside data society. while permeated by the media, bodies are in the front line of conflict between the documentation of the presents and the need to continue to abstract and imagine.
Information Worm is born on the surface of this battlefield, where improvisation marks a path across the uneven surface, allowing intuition and survival instinct to guide us through the rubble.
